request_text.title: Request
request_text.description: The developer's original plain-language infrastructure request.

requester.title: Requester
requester.description: Port user who submitted the request.

clarification_questions.title: Clarification Questions
clarification_questions.description: Questions asked back to the requester when details were missing.

clarification_answers.title: Clarification Answers
clarification_answers.description: The requester's answers to the clarification questions.

tech_plan.title: Tech Plan
tech_plan.description: Technical plan produced by the platform skills: module, inputs, environment and rationale.

policy_check.title: Policy Check
policy_check.description: Result of checking the plan against platform policy.

policy_check_details.title: Policy Check Details
policy_check_details.description: Which policies were checked and why the check passed or failed.

status.title: Status
status.description: Lifecycle stage of the request. manual_platform = no catalog module fits and the platform team took it to build by hand.

approver.title: Approver
approver.description: Port user who approved or rejected the request.

decision_reason.title: Decision Reason
decision_reason.description: Why the approver approved or rejected the request.

pr_url.title: Pull Request
pr_url.description: Link to the Terraform pull request opened for this request.

approval_mode.title: Approval mode
approval_mode.description: auto = approved by the rules, human = approved by the module owner, exception = guardrail violation approved as an exception by a manager.

data_sensitivity.title: Data sensitivity
data_sensitivity.description: Sensitivity of the data the requested resource will hold.

approval_reason.title: Approval reason
approval_reason.description: Why the request needs a person: production, confidential data, module requires approval, guardrail exception. Empty = auto-approved.

pr_requested_at.title: PR requested at
pr_requested_at.description: When the workflow started the Cursor PR step (used to spot stuck PRs).

pr_deadline.title: PR deadline
pr_deadline.description: Timer set to 30 minutes after the PR step starts. If it expires while the request is still pr_opening, an automation marks it pr_failed (stuck).

days_waiting.title: Days waiting
days_waiting.description: Days since the request last changed status.

waiting_on.title: Waiting on
waiting_on.description: Who or what the request is waiting on right now, derived from status and approval_reason.
waiting_on.calculation: if .properties.status == "awaiting_approval" then (if ((.properties.approval_reason // []) | index("guardrail exception")) != null then (if (.relations.terraform_module // null) == null then "Platform team decision (no module fits)" else "Exception approval (any Port user)" end) else "Module owning team approval" end) elif .properties.status == "manual_platform" then "Platform team: building it manually" elif .properties.status == "pr_opening" then "Coding agent is opening the PR" elif .properties.status == "pr_failed" then "Platform team: Retry PR" elif .properties.status == "pr_opened" then "PR review and merge" elif .properties.status == "rejected" then "You: fix and resubmit" elif .properties.status == "planned" then "AI planner" elif .properties.status == "approved" then "PR step starting" else (.properties.status // "unknown") end
